turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping takes 5-9 business days total from order placement to delivery. That includes 1-5 business days for processing (packing your order at our warehouse) plus transit time with the carrier.

One quick note: orders placed after 12 PM EST start processing the next business day. Standard shipping is free on orders $75+ or for Icon Rewards members, otherwise it's $7.
